annotations.title: Hidden character and AI watermark checker

description: Scan text for hidden and suspicious Unicode characters and return a cleaned copy. Finds zero-width space, joiner and non-joiner (U+200B to U+200D), word joiner U+2060, byte order mark U+FEFF, soft hyphen U+00AD, no-break and narrow no-break spaces, hair and thin spaces, bidirectional controls (U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069), variation selectors, Unicode tag characters U+E0000 to U+E007F (the invisible prompt-injection carrier, decoded to readable text in tagText), control characters, every other default-ignorable or format character (for example the Khmer inherent vowels U+17B4 and U+17B5 used to pad AI text), and Latin words containing Cyrillic or Greek lookalike letters. Curly quotes and dashes are reported separately as stylistic, not hidden. The cleaned text removes the invisible characters, turns special spaces into ordinary spaces and keeps zero-width joiners and selectors that form emoji. It cannot detect statistical AI watermarks such as SynthID-Text, which live in word choice. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/hidden-character-checker/

plainPunctuation.description: Also flatten curly quotes, en and em dashes and ellipses to plain ASCII in the cleaned text
